F47 and F52 are red under LD-5 and F51 under LD-6 and LD-9 by the equality assertion of waitLive (the exact filled text of the live line), which is stricter than the lint alone: a wrong word, a number or a price written into the live line fails at once with the text shown. The lint of the shown text runs on the same read after the wait, so a page script that writes a forbidden form into the live line is also found by the lint (it is read by body.innerText; #live is visually hidden, never display:none).
